headline: Fed Chair Powell: Path to a *soft landing* has narrowed
quote: Has it narrowed? Yes. Is it still possible? Yes.
title: Powell, Nov 2022: Path to a soft landing has narrowed
caption: Fed Chair Jerome Powell addressed whether the U.S. economy can avoid a recession while raising rates. He noted higher interest rates make achieving a soft landing increasingly difficult.
comment: Will the Fed successfully bring down inflation without causing a recession?
